title: clerodendrum silvanum var. nuxioides
intro: Clerodendrum silvanum var. nuxioides, commonly known as the "Malaysian Yellow Bitterleaf", is a plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae. This plant is reported to possess various health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Clerodendrum silvanum var. nuxioides are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include diterpenoids, sesquiterpenoids, and phenolic compounds, such as clerodane and labdane diterpenoids, and flavonoids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
